<align=center>Case Files Rules</align>

◆What Are Case Files?
In Case Files, you can deploy to 6 types of quests separate from the Main Cases.
These include "Robbery Pursuit," "Smuggling Crackdown," and "Regular Patrol," which can be challenged daily, as well as the high-difficulty "Special Investigation," "Dedicated Investigation," and "Extreme Trial."
*For Extreme Trial rules, please check the information on the Extreme Trial screen.

◆Robbery Pursuit / Smuggling Crackdown / Regular Patrol
Each can be challenged up to once a day.
Watching an ad adds 1 more attempt for each quest.
The further you progress through CASEs, the stronger the enemies become and the more rewards you can earn.

[Robbery Pursuit]
A quest where you can earn a large amount of Credits.

[Smuggling Crackdown]
A quest where you can earn a large amount of Enhancement Parts.
The type of Enhancement Part you can earn changes depending on the day of the week.
　Monday: Red Link Card Enhancement Part
　Tuesday: Green Link Card Enhancement Part
　Wednesday: Blue Link Card Enhancement Part
　Thursday: Red Base Card Enhancement Part
　Friday: Green Base Card Enhancement Part
　Saturday: Blue Base Card Enhancement Part
　Sunday: Random from all types

[Regular Patrol]
A quest where you can earn a large amount of Material.

◆Special Investigation
A high-difficulty quest featuring powerful enemies.
New quests are added as you progress through the Main Cases.
Each quest has 10 difficulty levels, and as the difficulty increases, special rules are added, making it harder.
Clearing it earns you "Lab Chips," which let you perform special updates in the Lab.
No Stamina is consumed to take part.

◆Dedicated Investigation
A high-difficulty quest that can only be challenged with specific Buddies.
You will fight consecutively against boss enemies.
New quests are added as you unlock new Buddies.
Like Special Investigation, it has 10 difficulty levels, and as the difficulty increases, special rules are added, making it harder.
Clearing it earns you "Over Material," which is required to level up a Buddy at certain levels.
No Stamina is consumed to take part.

◆Extreme Trial
For the Extreme Trial, please check the information on the Extreme Trial screen.

<align=center>Extreme Trial Rules</align>

◆Game Rules
The Extreme Trial is a quest made up of up to 12 CHASEs.
As you progress through the quest, at set points you can choose from 3 options for how much to raise the Risk value — the higher the Risk, the stronger the enemies become, but the easier it also becomes to aim for a high score.
The higher the score you earn, the higher the drop rate for rare rewards.
You may also obtain a "Support Badge" as a clear reward, which grants an ability effect when equipped.
Note that no Stamina is consumed to take part. You can challenge up to 3 times a day, and watching an ad can add 1 more attempt per day; there is no limit to additional attempts gained by spending Quartz.
You will be defeated once your HP reaches 0.
*Clearing 12 CHASEs under certain conditions may add a special stage.

◆Event Period
Held on a weekly cycle, from Monday 3:00 AM to 2:59 AM the following Monday.

◆Rank and Grouping Rules
The Extreme Trial has 8 League tiers in total, and players start at the "Rookie" rank.
Each week, League promotion and demotion are determined based on your ranking from your high score during the period.
The higher the League, the higher the drop rate for rare rewards.
Each League also has ranking rewards, and the higher your League and rank, the more "Extreme Trial Points" you can earn.
These points can be exchanged for any item you like at the Exchange.

◆Group Division and Promotion/Demotion Rules for Each League
There are 8 Leagues in total.
Rookie < Iron < Bronze < Silver < Gold < Platinum < Diamond < Dominator

Each group is made up of up to 100 people.
The number of people subject to promotion or demotion is determined as a percentage of the group's total participants.

[Rookie]
Top 60% are promoted, the rest remain

[Iron]
Top 55% are promoted, bottom 5% are demoted, the rest remain

[Bronze]
Top 50% are promoted, bottom 10% are demoted, the rest remain

[Silver]
Top 45% are promoted, bottom 15% are demoted, the rest remain

[Gold]
Top 40% are promoted, bottom 20% are demoted, the rest remain

[Platinum]
Top 35% are promoted, bottom 25% are demoted, the rest remain

[Diamond]
Top 30% are promoted, bottom 30% are demoted, the rest remain

[Dominator]
Bottom 60% are demoted, the rest remain

[If a group has fewer than 30 participants]
If a group has fewer than 30 participants, that group's results are invalidated.
No League promotion or demotion will occur, and everyone will remain at their current League.
Additionally, ranking rewards will not be granted.
